name: CreateService

parameters.help_en: The region ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: A client token used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value for this parameter from your client. \`ClientToken\` supports only ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The service ID
parameters.name: service_id

parameters.help_en:
The deployment type. Valid values:

ros: The service is deployed using ROS.

terraform: The service is deployed using Terraform.

ack: The service is deployed using ACK.

spi: The service is deployed by invoking an SPI.

operation: The service is an O\&M service
parameters.help_zh:
部署类型。可能值：

ros：通过ROS部署。

terraform：通过Terraform部署。

ack：通过ACK部署。

spi：调用SPI部署。

operation：代运维服务部署
parameters.name: deploy_type

parameters.help_en: The deployment configuration of the service. The information stored varies by deployment type. Different deployment types have different data formats. The data is stored in a JSON string
parameters.help_zh: 存储服务部署配置的信息。存储的信息与部署类型有关，不同的部署类型存储的数据格式不一样，因此使用JSON String格式进行数据存储。
parameters.name: deploy_metadata

parameters.help_en:
The service type. Valid values:

private: The service instance is deployed in the user's account.

managed: The service instance is managed in the service provider's account.

operation: An O\&M service instance.

poc: A trial service instance
parameters.help_zh:
服务类型。可能的值：

private：部署在用户账户下的服务实例。

managed：托管在服务商账户下的服务实例。

operation：代运维服务实例

poc：试用服务实例
parameters.name: service_type

element_fields.help_en:
The language of the service. Valid values:

zh-CN: Chinese.

en-US: English
element_fields.help_zh:
服务语言。可能的值：

zh-CN：中文。

en-US：英文
element_fields.name: locale

element_fields.example: TiDB is an open-source distributed relational database designed and developed by Company A.

element_fields.name: image

parameters.help_en: The service details
parameters.name: service_info

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable O\&M. Default value: false. Valid values:

true: Enabled.

false: Disabled.

This parameter is required when \`ServiceType\` is set to \`private\`
parameters.help_zh:
是否代运维，默认为：false。可能的值：

true：开启。

false：关闭。
当ServiceType为private时需要填入该值
parameters.name: is_support_operated

parameters.help_en: The policy name. The name of a single policy can be up to 128 characters in length. Separate multiple names with commas (,). Only policies related to O\&M parameters are supported
parameters.help_zh: 策略名称。单个策略名称长度不超过128个字符，多个名称使用英文逗号（,）分隔。暂时只支持代运维相关参数策略
parameters.name: policy_names

parameters.help_en: The O\&M duration. Unit: seconds
parameters.name: duration

parameters.help_en:
The alert configurations for the service.

This configuration takes effect only after an alert-related access policy is configured in \`PolicyNames\`
parameters.help_zh:
服务报警配置。
当PolicyNames中配置了报警权限策略后，该配置才会生效
parameters.name: alarm_metadata

parameters.help_en:
The sharing type. Valid values:

Public: The service is public. Full and trial deployments are not restricted.

Restricted: The service is restricted. Full and trial deployments are restricted.

OnlyFormalRestricted: Only full deployments are restricted.

OnlyTrailRestricted: Only trial deployments are restricted.

Hidden: The service is hidden. It is not visible and you cannot request deployment permissions
parameters.help_zh:
共享类型。可能的值：

Public：公开的，正式部署和试用部署都不受限。

Restricted：受限的，正式部署和试用部署都受限。

OnlyFormalRestricted：仅正式部署受限。

OnlyTrailRestricted：仅试用部署受限。

Hidden：隐藏的，不可见且不可申请部署权限
parameters.name: share_type

parameters.help_en:
The approval type for service usage requests. Valid values:

Manual: The request requires manual approval.

AutoPass: The request is automatically approved
parameters.help_zh:
服务使用申请审批类型。可能的值：

Manual：收到审批。

AutoPass：自动通过
